# DeletedMessagesHandler

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.handlers.DeletedMessagesHandler`

## Constructor

```python
def __init__(callback: Callable, filters: Filter = None): ...
```

## Documentation

The deleted messages handler class. Used to handle deleted messages coming from any chat
(private, group, channel). It is intended to be used with [`add_handler`](../methods/utilities/add_handler.md)

For a nicer way to register this handler, have a look at the
[`on_deleted_messages`](../decorators/on_deleted_messages.md) decorator.

### Parameters

- **`callback`** (`Callable`)
  Pass a function that will be called when one or more messages have been deleted.
  It takes *(client, messages)* as positional arguments (look at the section below for a detailed description).

- **`filters`** (`Filters`)
  Pass one or more filters to allow only a subset of messages to be passed
  in your callback function.

Other parameters:
    client (`Client`):
        The Client itself, useful when you want to call other API methods inside the message handler.

    messages (List of [`Message`](../types/messages_and_media/Message.md)):
        The deleted messages, as list.
